evidence.detail: No win streak achievement or SQL exists anywhere in the codebase

PerfectRun and FlawlessRun achievements track within-run wins, but there is no cross-competition consecutive-win tracking; implementing win streak requires defining scope (league? tournament? all?) and writing window-function SQL over ordered match results

triage.notes: Needs product clarification on what constitutes a 'win streak' (league runs, tournament rounds, all matches combined?) before SQL can be designed; tracking consecutive wins across different competitions requires non-trivial ordered aggregation.
